# mergewf_scim_user (Resource)

Provisions a SCIM user using the separate SCIM token. Updates use PUT replacement semantics. Do not manage the same object from an identity provider and Terraform. Import using the SCIM ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_scim_user" "example" {
  user_name    = "alex@example.com"
  display_name = "Alex Example"
  active       = true
  emails       = [{ value = "alex@example.com", primary = true, type = "work" }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
